Our Story

A family turf farm, now a trusted wholesale partner.

Original Turf Growers started as a single acre of Bermuda grass and a promise to landscapers: turf that's cut fresh, never stored.

Today we grow Mexican lawn, Bermuda lawn and Buffalo grass across our own farms, and work directly with landscaping contractors, plant nurseries, resorts and homeowners who need turf, ornamental plants and trees delivered on schedule and installed right.

Every roll is harvested to order — so what reaches your site is days old, not weeks old.

Straight From The Farm

Grown under open sky, cut to your order.

No warehousing, no ageing stock. Every roll you get was still rooted in our fields days before it reaches your site — that's the whole reason our turf establishes faster and greener.
